correctness.rationale: For every Gamma(shape κ>0, unit scale), the real mean-zero degree≤2 polynomial plane is spanned by P₁=X−κ and P₂=X²−2(κ+1)X+κ(κ+1). Exact rising-factorial moments yield E(P₁+tP₂)²=κ[1+2(κ+1)t²] and the stated quartic Bκ(t). Symbolic differentiation gives Kκ′=−48(κ+1)Qκ(t)/[κ(1+2(κ+1)t²)³]. The quartic discriminant is strictly negative because its positive factor is (2κ²−5κ/2−21)²+(63/4)κ²+63κ; with Qκ(0)=−1 and positive leading coefficient, exactly two simple real roots t₋<0<t₊ exist. The directional derivative in projective coordinate s=1/t is nonzero at pure P₂, so t₋ and t₊ give unique global minimum and maximum. γ→normal eighth-moment convergence supports endpoint limits 3,15. Independently rederived exact moment/derivative/discriminant identities with symbolic algebra and verified κ=2 minimum 15/7 at t=−1/6. Finite diagnostics alone are not the universal proof.
